userGoal: A repair-jammed droid shows the approved no-repair-2 status icon beside its HP while jammed and it disappears when the status ends.
inScope: BattleUnitView owns a visible world-space repair-jammer sprite child.
BattleUnitPresenter exposes a narrow forwarding method.
BattleSceneController refreshes the visual from BattleSimulation.IsUnitRepairJammed during normal unit-view presentation.
A focused Unity EditMode test asserts active and inactive states with the real Resources texture.
completionCriteria: Calling the view's public repair-jammer state entry renders the approved sprite beside the HP label.
Clearing the state hides the same sprite child.
Normal controller refresh provides the current simulation status through the presenter.
prohibitedTestWeakening: Do not replace the real Resources texture with a test-only placeholder.
Do not assert only a private field or call count.
Do not remove the inactive-state assertion.
